en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Natana (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from `Abdullah b. al-Fadl al-Hashimi from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Blessed is he who lives a long life and beautifies his actions, for his ending will be good if his Lord is pleased with him. Woe to he who lives a long life and commits evil, for his ending will be evil if his Lord is discontented with him.
